 RRB Paramedical Exam Date 2026: CBT on 23 & 25 November, City Intimation Slip and Admit Card Updates
 RRB Paramedical Exam 2026 will be conducted on 23 and 25 November. Candidates can check their exam city around 10 days before the CBT and download the RRB Paramedical Admit Card around four days before their respective examination dates. Roshni Yadav 13 Nov, 2026 Share

 Important Instructions for RRB Paramedical Exam 2026 
 The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have announced the tentative examination schedule for the RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026 under Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) 05/2026. The Computer-Based Test (CBT) will be conducted on 23 November and 25 November 2026 to recruit candidates for 590 paramedical vacancies across different posts.
 The RRB Paramedical Exam City Intimation Slip is scheduled to be made available around 10 days before the respective examination dates. Candidates can use the city intimation facility to check their allotted examination city and date. The RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 (e-call letter) will be available approximately four days before the respective CBT date.
 Candidates should check their regional RRB websites regularly for the latest examination updates, download links and instructions.

 RRB Paramedical Exam Date 2026: Official Schedule
 The Railway Recruitment Boards released the tentative CBT examination schedule for paramedical categories under CEN 05/2026 on 18 October 2026.
 According to the official examination notice, the RRB Paramedical CBT will take place on two dates: 23 November and 25 November 2026. Candidates should check their individual exam date through the city and date intimation facility.

 RRB Paramedical City Intimation Slip 2026
 The RRB Paramedical City Intimation Slip 2026 helps candidates know the city where their examination centre will be located. The Railway Recruitment Boards will activate the exam city and date link approximately 10 days before the respective examination date.
 Candidates appearing on 23 November can check their city intimation around 13 November 2026. Those appearing on 25 November should check the link around 15 November 2026.
 The city intimation slip is different from the admit card. It provides advance information about the examination city and date so candidates can plan their travel arrangements.
 Details mentioned on the city intimation slip:
 Candidate's name and registration details
 Examination city
 Examination date
 Recruitment and examination information
 Travel authority for eligible SC/ST candidates
 Candidates should remember that the city intimation slip is not an entry pass to the examination centre. They must download their e-call letter before appearing for the CBT.
 RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 Release Date
 The Railway Recruitment Boards will release the RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 approximately four days before the respective examination date. The admit card is also known as the e-call letter.
 Based on the official release timeline, the expected admit card dates are given below.
 Exam Date 
 Expected Admit Card Date 
 23 November 2026 
 19 November 2026 
 25 November 2026 
 21 November 2026 
 Candidates must download their e-call letters from the respective regional RRB websites using their registration number and date of birth or other required login credentials.
 The admit card contains important examination information, including the reporting time, examination centre address, shift details and candidate instructions. Candidates should carefully check all the details after downloading it.
 How to Download RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026?
 Candidates can follow the steps below to download the RRB Paramedical Hall Ticket 2026 once the link becomes active:
 Visit the official RRB website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in .
 Open the regional RRB website from which you submitted your application.
 Find the link for RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 under the latest notifications.
 Click the e-call letter download link.
 Enter your registration number and date of birth or the required login details.
 Submit the information to access your admit card.
 Download the hall ticket and take a clear printout for examination day.
 Candidates should keep their login details ready to avoid last-minute difficulties.
 RRB Paramedical Exam 2026: Aadhaar Biometric Verification
 According to the examination schedule notice, Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication will be conducted at the examination centre before candidates are allowed to enter the examination hall.
 Candidates must carry their original Aadhaar card or a printout of their e-verified Aadhaar to the examination centre. They should ensure that their Aadhaar details are correct and follow the verification instructions issued by the RRB.
 Documents Required for RRB Paramedical CBT 2026
 Candidates should keep the following documents ready for the examination:
 Printed copy of the RRB Paramedical e-call letter.
 Original Aadhaar card or printout of e-verified Aadhaar.
 Valid photo identity proof, as specified in the e-call letter.
 Other documents or certificates mentioned in the official examination instructions.
 Candidates should read the instructions printed on their admit cards carefully before travelling to the examination centre.
 RRB Paramedical Selection Process 2026
 The RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026 selection process includes the following stages:
 Computer-Based Test (CBT): Candidates must appear for the online examination and qualify according to the applicable recruitment criteria.
 Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be called for verification of their educational qualifications, category certificates and other required documents.
 Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the prescribed medical standards for their respective posts.
 Final selection will be based on the applicable recruitment rules, merit and eligibility requirements.
 Important Instructions for RRB Paramedical Exam 2026
 Candidates appearing for the RRB Paramedical CBT should follow these important instructions:
 Download the e-call letter as soon as the link becomes available.
 Check the examination date, shift and reporting time mentioned on the admit card.
 Carry the required identity documents to the examination centre.
 Complete Aadhaar-linked biometric verification at the examination centre.
 Reach the examination centre according to the reporting time mentioned on the e-call letter.
 Do not rely on unofficial websites for examination updates.
 Follow all instructions issued by the respective Railway Recruitment Board.
 RRB Paramedical Exam Date 2026 FAQs
 When will the RRB Paramedical Exam 2026 be conducted?
 The RRB Paramedical CBT 2026 is scheduled to be conducted on 23 and 25 November 2026 under CEN 05/2026. When will the RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 be released?
 The RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 is expected to be released approximately four days before the respective examination date. Candidates appearing on 23 November can expect their admit cards on 19 November 2026. How can I download the RRB Paramedical City Intimation Slip 2026?
